title: Main Client
description: An all-in-one quality-of-life modpack for Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric, ready for solo creative worlds or playing on a server with friends.
body:
# Main Client

**Main Client** is an all-in-one quality-of-life modpack for **Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric)**. It bundles a curated selection of QoL mods and resource packs into a single ready-to-play package, so you can install once and jump straight into either a solo creative world or a server with friends — no extra configuration required.

## What This Modpack Does

Main Client combines a large collection of **quality-of-life mods** and **resource packs** that are hand-picked to work together. The goal is a smoother, cleaner, better-looking game out of the box, without you having to assemble and test a mod list yourself.

## Why Download It

- **Built for Minecraft 26.2** — the Chaos Cubed (Sulfur) drop, fully up to date
- **Quality-of-life mods** — interface, performance, and convenience improvements throughout
- **Bundled resource packs** — a consistent, upgraded visual style included by default
- **Sulfur content ready** — set up to work with 26.2's new sulfur blocks, cinnabar, and Sulfur Cube
- **Friends system** — integrated multiplayer support for playing alongside friends
- **Equally at home solo or online** — designed to play well in a random creative world *or* a server with friends

## How To Use It

1. Make sure your launcher is set up for **Minecraft 26.2** with the **Fabric** loader.
2. Install Main Client through your preferred launcher.
3. Launch the pack.
4. Start a creative world, survival world, or connect to a server with friends. Your choice! — the pack is configured to handle everything.

## Before You Download

This is a curated modpack rather than a single mod. You'll need the **Fabric loader for 26.2** (most launchers handle this automatically). Note that 26.2 requires **Java 25**, so make sure your system has it before launching.
